answer: An operator running many aliases hence burns for many distinct network origins and accepts the latency of spreading them thin, while each origin still has to clear the zephyr quota and the delta admission check. Submission rate is limited to 10 per autonomous system per minute, so a datacentre cannot pull quota for a whole swarm from one uplink. Because the counters live in the nebula ledger, a burst across neighbours is visible at replay instead of hidden. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
